Page.title: About & Contact
Page.description: Call or email Ajared Research Inc. in Toronto (+1 613 661 3550) or Abuja (+234 805 064 4454). An applied research and product studio that builds data products and information systems for businesses.

Header.Description: Who we are, how we work, and how to reach us in Toronto and Abuja.

Actions.Lead: Have a project in mind? Tell us about it. We reply within 48–72 hours.

About.Purpose: Make things better by making better things.

Intro.P: Ajared Research Inc. is an applied research and product studio. We build data products and information systems for businesses, using technology to solve real business problems.

We work with founder-led startups and small teams across North America and Nigeria who want AI and data working in a real product or workflow now, not another proof of concept. Over the long run we are building toward a platform of products and systems for cities.

Group.title: Why Ajared
Group.Item: We cut out the fluff and deliver what is actually useful.
Strategy, PRD, design and build under one roof, so nothing gets lost between handoffs.
Delivery from Canada and Nigeria: high-quality work with diverse perspectives.

Group.title: The Ajared Way
Group.note: Our proven process. Each step stands alone, so start wherever you are.
Group.Item: A free readiness check of your business, data and technology, with an action plan.
A 30-minute conversation with a practitioner about fit and priorities.
A PRD, user journeys and flows, so everyone knows what is being built.
We build and ship in four weeks.
Learnings, embedded tools and systems, and a roadmap forward.

Group.title: Core Values
Group.Item: Simple is not easy, but it is still useful.
Curious, always learning, improving through tiny experiments.
We keep our commitments, and renegotiate early when we need to.
A possibility mentality, plus discipline, plus capacity.
